question: How many customers are registered in the system?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers

question: How many vehicles are in the fleet table in total?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vehicles

question: List the name and city of every branch.
gold_sql: SELECT name, city FROM branches

question: How many vehicles are currently available for rent?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vehicles WHERE status = 'available'

question: What is the standard daily rate of the Luxury category?
gold_sql: SELECT daily_rate FROM vehicle_categories WHERE name = 'Luxury'

question: How many rentals have been cancelled?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rentals WHERE status = 'cancelled'

question: What is the total amount of all payments with status paid?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM payments WHERE status = 'paid'

question: How many customers are in the Gold loyalty tier?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE loyalty_tier = 'Gold'

question: What is the highest single maintenance cost ever recorded?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(cost) FROM maintenance

question: How many Toyota vehicles does the company own?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vehicles WHERE make = 'Toyota'

question: Which payment methods are used by customers?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT method FROM payments

question: How many customers joined in 2024?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE strftime('%Y', date_joined) = '2024'

question: What is the average mileage of the vehicles in the fleet?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(mileage) FROM vehicles

question: How many rentals are currently active?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rentals WHERE status = 'active'

question: What is the oldest model year among our vehicles?
gold_sql: SELECT MIN(year) FROM vehicles

question: How many vehicles does each branch have? Show the branch name and the vehicle count.
gold_sql: SELECT b.name, COUNT(*) FROM vehicles v JOIN branches b ON v.branch_id = b.branch_id GROUP BY b.branch_id, b.name

question: What is the total revenue from completed rentals for each pickup branch? Show the branch name and the total.
gold_sql: SELECT b.name, SUM(r.total_amount) FROM rentals r JOIN branches b ON r.pickup_branch_id = b.branch_id WHERE r.status = 'completed' GROUP BY b.branch_id, b.name

question: Show the top 5 customers by total spend on completed rentals, with first name, last name and total spend.
gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(r.total_amount) AS total_spend FROM customers c JOIN rentals r ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE r.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY total_spend DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the average rental length in days for each vehicle category? Use completed rentals and show the category name and the average days.
gold_sql: SELECT vc.name, AVG(julianday(r.end_date) - julianday(r.start_date)) FROM rentals r JOIN vehicles v ON r.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id JOIN vehicle_categories vc ON v.category_id = vc.category_id WHERE r.status = 'completed' GROUP BY vc.category_id, vc.name

question: How much money was received per payment method? Only count payments with status paid.
gold_sql: SELECT method, SUM(amount) FROM payments WHERE status = 'paid' GROUP BY method

question: How many non-cancelled rentals started in each month of 2025? Show the month as YYYY-MM and the count.
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', start_date) AS month, COUNT(*) FROM rentals WHERE status <> 'cancelled' AND strftime('%Y', start_date) = '2025' GROUP BY month

question: Which vehicle category earned the most revenue from completed rentals? Show the category name and the revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT vc.name, SUM(r.total_amount) AS revenue FROM rentals r JOIN vehicles v ON r.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id JOIN vehicle_categories vc ON v.category_id = vc.category_id WHERE r.status = 'completed' GROUP BY vc.category_id, vc.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many different customers have made at least one non-cancelled rental?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM rentals WHERE status <> 'cancelled'

question: What is the total maintenance cost for the vehicles of each branch? Show the branch name and the total cost.
gold_sql: SELECT b.name, SUM(m.cost) FROM maintenance m JOIN vehicles v ON m.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id JOIN branches b ON v.branch_id = b.branch_id GROUP BY b.branch_id, b.name

question: What is the average maintenance cost for each service type?
gold_sql: SELECT service_type, AVG(cost) FROM maintenance GROUP BY service_type

question: How many completed rentals were returned late (actual return after the planned end date) for each pickup branch? Show the branch name and the count.
gold_sql: SELECT b.name, COUNT(*) FROM rentals r JOIN branches b ON r.pickup_branch_id = b.branch_id WHERE r.status = 'completed' AND r.actual_return_date > r.end_date GROUP BY b.branch_id, b.name

question: Which pickup branch has the highest number of cancelled rentals? Show the branch name and the count.
gold_sql: SELECT b.name, COUNT(*) AS cancelled FROM rentals r JOIN branches b ON r.pickup_branch_id = b.branch_id WHERE r.status = 'cancelled' GROUP BY b.branch_id, b.name ORDER BY cancelled DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the total pending payment amount for each payment method?
gold_sql: SELECT method, SUM(amount) FROM payments WHERE status = 'pending' GROUP BY method

question: List the plate number and branch name of all vehicles that are currently in maintenance.
gold_sql: SELECT v.plate_number, b.name FROM vehicles v JOIN branches b ON v.branch_id = b.branch_id WHERE v.status = 'maintenance'

question: For vehicle makes that have more than 5 vehicles, show the make and the average mileage.
gold_sql: SELECT make, AVG(mileage) FROM vehicles GROUP BY make HAVING COUNT(*) > 5

question: How many non-cancelled rentals started in each year? Show the year and the count.
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', start_date) AS year, COUNT(*) FROM rentals WHERE status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY year

question: Which customers have rented an SUV more than 3 times (non-cancelled rentals)? Show first name, last name and the number of SUV rentals.
gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(*) FROM customers c JOIN rentals r ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN vehicles v ON r.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id JOIN vehicle_categories vc ON v.category_id = vc.category_id WHERE vc.name = 'SUV' AND r.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 3

question: How many customers have never made a rental of any kind?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers c LEFT JOIN rentals r ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE r.rental_id IS NULL

question: Show the top 3 vehicles by total maintenance cost with their plate number, make, model and total cost.
gold_sql: SELECT v.plate_number, v.make, v.model, SUM(m.cost) AS total_cost FROM maintenance m JOIN vehicles v ON m.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id GROUP BY v.vehicle_id ORDER BY total_cost DESC LIMIT 3

question: What is the average total amount of completed rentals for each customer loyalty tier? Show the tier and the average.
gold_sql: SELECT c.loyalty_tier, AVG(r.total_amount) FROM rentals r JOIN customers c ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE r.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.loyalty_tier

question: How many customers have a total spend on completed rentals above the average total spend of customers who have at least one completed rental?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id, SUM(total_amount) AS s FROM rentals WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY customer_id) WHERE s > (SELECT AVG(s2) FROM (SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS s2 FROM rentals WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY customer_id))

question: List the plate number, make and model of vehicles that have no rental records at all.
gold_sql: SELECT v.plate_number, v.make, v.model FROM vehicles v WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rentals r WHERE r.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id)

question: How many vehicles have at least one rental but no maintenance record?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vehicles v WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rentals r WHERE r.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM maintenance m WHERE m.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id)

question: Which active rentals are overdue (planned end date before today and the vehicle not yet returned)? Show the rental id and the customer's first and last name.
gold_sql: SELECT r.rental_id, c.first_name, c.last_name FROM rentals r JOIN customers c ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE r.status = 'active' AND r.end_date < '2025-12-31' AND r.actual_return_date IS NULL

question: In which month of 2025 was the revenue from completed rentals (grouped by start date) the highest? Show the month as YYYY-MM and the revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', start_date) AS month, SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM rentals WHERE status = 'completed' AND strftime('%Y', start_date) = '2025' GROUP BY month ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many customers have picked up vehicles from at least 3 different branches (non-cancelled rentals)?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM rentals WHERE status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pickup_branch_id) >= 3)

question: For each pickup branch, how many one-way rentals were there (vehicle returned at a different branch than it was picked up)? Exclude cancelled rentals and show the branch name and the count.
gold_sql: SELECT b.name, COUNT(*) FROM rentals r JOIN branches b ON r.pickup_branch_id = b.branch_id WHERE r.return_branch_id <> r.pickup_branch_id AND r.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY b.branch_id, b.name

question: What was the difference in completed-rental revenue between 2025 and 2024 (2025 minus 2024), based on the rental start date?
gold_sql: SELECT (SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM rentals WHERE status = 'completed' AND strftime('%Y', start_date) = '2025') - (SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM rentals WHERE status = 'completed' AND strftime('%Y', start_date) = '2024')

question: For how many customers was their most recent rental (by start date) cancelled?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers c WHERE (SELECT r.status FROM rentals r WHERE r.customer_id = c.customer_id ORDER BY r.start_date DESC, r.rental_id DESC LIMIT 1) = 'cancelled'

question: How many completed rentals have paid payments that add up to less than the rental's total amount?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rentals r WHERE r.status = 'completed' AND COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.amount) FROM payments p WHERE p.rental_id = r.rental_id AND p.status = 'paid'), 0) < r.total_amount

question: How many customers have both rented a Luxury vehicle and had at least one late return (completed rental returned after its planned end date)? Ignore cancelled rentals.
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rentals r JOIN vehicles v ON r.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id JOIN vehicle_categories vc ON v.category_id = vc.category_id WHERE r.customer_id = c.customer_id AND vc.name = 'Luxury' AND r.status <> 'cancelled') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rentals r2 WHERE r2.customer_id = c.customer_id AND r2.status = 'completed' AND r2.actual_return_date > r2.end_date)

question: Show each month of 2025 with its completed-rental revenue (by start date) and the running total of revenue up to and including that month.
gold_sql: SELECT month, revenue, SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS running_total FROM (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', start_date) AS month, SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM rentals WHERE status = 'completed' AND strftime('%Y', start_date) = '2025' GROUP BY month)

question: For each pickup branch, what percentage of its completed rentals were returned late? Round to 1 decimal place and show the branch name and the percentage.
gold_sql: SELECT b.name, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.actual_return_date > r.end_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) FROM rentals r JOIN branches b ON r.pickup_branch_id = b.branch_id WHERE r.status = 'completed' GROUP BY b.branch_id, b.name

question: Which vehicles with a model year before 2021 have accumulated more than 50000 PKR of maintenance cost? Show the plate number, model year and total maintenance cost.
gold_sql: SELECT v.plate_number, v.year, SUM(m.cost) AS total_cost FROM vehicles v JOIN maintenance m ON m.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id WHERE v.year < 2021 GROUP BY v.vehicle_id HAVING SUM(m.cost) > 50000

question: Which branch has the highest average revenue per completed rental, considering only branches with at least 350 completed rentals? Show the branch name and the average.
gold_sql: SELECT b.name, AVG(r.total_amount) AS avg_rev FROM rentals r JOIN branches b ON r.pickup_branch_id = b.branch_id WHERE r.status = 'completed' GROUP BY b.branch_id, b.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 350 ORDER BY avg_rev DESC LIMIT 1
